failure: Remote review attestation rejected before launcher preflight
diagnosis: The review body itself was a clean Codex result and the remote object was unchanged. The recorded hash was computed from a shell pipeline that appended a trailing newline to the body before hashing; the verifier hashes the API body bytes without that newline. This was an attestation-construction error, not a substantive review or code change.
v5_policy: Remote review attestations are checked before one-use marker consumption. A committed attestation retains the original body hash; execution preflight verifies remote identity, clean outcome, and reviewed commit while recording any later body-hash drift instead of silently treating a cosmetic edit as a missing review.
